children: New agentic AI capabilities compress life and annuities insurance product launch cycles, optimize in-force policy management, and move health plan payment integrity upstream

[NASDAQ: EXLS], a global data and AI company, announced it has integrated agentic AI across core solutions for insurance and healthcare, combining workflow orchestration, enterprise data intelligence and AI-powered automation to modernize operations and deliver better experiences for its clients. As part of its portfolio of integrated AI-led solutions, EXL is embedding AI agents directly into the offerings where its clients already work. This includes reimagining two of EXL’s industry-leading solutions, EXL LifePRO and
, with AI-powered automation to help modernize operations and deliver better outcomes.

EXL LifePRO Agentic Suite™ addresses a central challenge confronting the life insurance industry: slow product launch cycles. Most life insurers still need eight to ten months to bring a new product to market, a constraint that limits how many products a carrier can launch each year and how quickly it can respond to regulatory or competitive changes. According to a 2025 LIMRA and Bain & Company study, approximately 100 million Americans say they need life insurance but haven’t purchased it, yet just 9.4 million policies were sold in 2024. Carriers are largely competing for the same buyers, leaving a large gap in demand unaddressed.

By automating manual, repetitive workflows, EXL LifePRO Agentic Suite compresses the product launch cycle to as few as 16 weeks, leveraging AI agents to ingest product specifications, interpret rules and rates, and propose executable configurations so teams can focus on reviewing and approval rather than build from scratch. The suite also makes conversions and implementation faster and easier, increasing straight-through processing across the board, with gains ranging from 18-60%, while built-in validation runs scenarios across coverage amounts, channels and jurisdictions, with full audit trails from actuarial, risk, and compliance sign-off. EXL clients have already seen approximately 30-40% reductions in configuration and testing efforts using this newly enhanced capability.

EXL Payment Integrity supports an industry-wide evolution toward real-time loss prevention, as health plans shift from reactive post-payment recovery to pre-pay decisioning. EXL’s agentic AI for payment integrity deploys a coordinated set of AI agents, each with a distinct role, to connect clinical, coding, and payment decisions; automates routine investigations; and routes complex cases to human experts. Unlike fragmented point solutions, EXL's coordinated intelligence compounds across every audit and recovery, continuously closing the gap between insight and realized savings. The effect is measurable: auditors handling high-yield clinical reviews are approximately 50% more productive, and health plans running AI across all audit types see approximately 15–20% per member per month savings growth without adding headcount.

“We’re at an inflection point where AI stops being something you add to work and starts being how work gets done,” said Vikas Bhalla, president and head of AI services and operations at EXL. “These solutions reflect years of domain expertise in insurance and healthcare translated into AI that operates inside the workflow, not on top of it. With EXL LifePRO Agentic Suite, we’re giving life insurers the ability to significantly simplify product launches, minimize complexity for conversions and implementations and increase the straight through processes by three times the average rate. With EXL Payment Integrity, we’re helping health plans shift from chasing overpayments to preventing them, at scale and with confidence.”
To learn more about how EXL is reimagining insurance and healthcare with agentic AI, explore the EXL LifePRO Agentic Suite and EXL Payment Integrity with agentic AI, both available now.
